CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW etf_transaction_updated AS  SELECT t.id,
    t.ticker AS "Ticker",
    t.quantita AS "Quantità",
    round(abs((t.importo_euro / t.quantita)), 2) AS "Prezzo di acquisto",
    COALESCE(ep.price, (abs((t.importo_euro / t.quantita)))::double precision) AS "Prezzo corrente",
    abs(t.importo_euro) AS "Costo",
    ((COALESCE(ep.price, (abs((t.importo_euro / t.quantita)))::double precision) * (t.quantita)::double precision))::numeric AS "Market Value",
    round(((((COALESCE(ep.price, (abs((t.importo_euro / t.quantita)))::double precision) - (abs((t.importo_euro / t.quantita)))::double precision) / (abs((t.importo_euro / t.quantita)))::double precision) * (100)::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS "Crescita %",
    'EUR'::text AS "Valuta",
    t.data_operazione AS "Data acquisto",
    split_part((t.descrizione)::text, ' '::text, 1) AS "Emittente",
    t.isin AS "ISIN",
    now() AS created_at,
    now() AS updated_at
   FROM (transaction t
     LEFT JOIN etf_prices ep ON (((t.ticker)::text = (ep.ticker)::text)))
  WHERE (((t.isin)::text <> '0'::text) AND (t.protocollo = 0.0) AND ((t.ticker)::text !~~ 'M.%'::text))
  ORDER BY t.data_operazione DESC;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW unique_tickers_view AS  SELECT DISTINCT etf_ticker
   FROM etf_holdings
  WHERE (etf_ticker IN ( SELECT DISTINCT t.ticker
           FROM transaction t
          WHERE ((t.ticker)::text !~~ 'M.%'::text)));;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_asset_allocation AS  WITH bonds_total AS (
         SELECT 'Bond'::text AS asset_class,
            abs(sum(transaction.importo_euro)) AS market_value
           FROM transaction
          WHERE (((transaction.ticker)::text ~~ 'M.%'::text) AND ((transaction.tipo_operazione)::text = 'Acquisto'::text))
        ), commodities_total AS (
         SELECT 'Commodities'::text AS asset_class,
            sum(v_dist_etf.market_value_attuale) AS market_value
           FROM v_dist_etf
          WHERE ((v_dist_etf.ticker)::text IN ( SELECT etf_holdings.etf_ticker
                   FROM etf_holdings
                  WHERE (etf_holdings.settore = 'Materie prime'::text)))
        ), stocks_total AS (
         SELECT 'Azioni'::text AS asset_class,
            sum(v_dist_etf.market_value_attuale) AS market_value
           FROM v_dist_etf
          WHERE (NOT ((v_dist_etf.ticker)::text IN ( SELECT etf_holdings.etf_ticker
                   FROM etf_holdings
                  WHERE (etf_holdings.settore = 'Materie prime'::text))))
        ), all_assets AS (
         SELECT bonds_total.asset_class,
            bonds_total.market_value
           FROM bonds_total
        UNION ALL
         SELECT commodities_total.asset_class,
            commodities_total.market_value
           FROM commodities_total
        UNION ALL
         SELECT stocks_total.asset_class,
            stocks_total.market_value
           FROM stocks_total
        ), portfolio_total AS (
         SELECT sum(all_assets.market_value) AS total_value
           FROM all_assets
        )
 SELECT a.asset_class,
    a.market_value,
    round((((a.market_value / p.total_value) * (100)::double precision))::numeric, 2) AS percentage,
    p.total_value AS portfolio_total
   FROM (all_assets a
     CROSS JOIN portfolio_total p)
  ORDER BY a.market_value DESC;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_bottom_3_etf_guadagni AS  SELECT ticker,
    costo_investito_eur,
    market_value_attuale,
    guadagno_eur,
    guadagno_pct
   FROM v_etf_performance
  WHERE (guadagno_pct IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY guadagno_pct, market_value_attuale DESC, ticker
 LIMIT 3;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_dist_area_geografica AS  WITH base AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(hn.area_geografica, 'Non mappato'::text) AS area_geografica,
            ((k.market_value_attuale)::numeric * COALESCE((hn.peso_norm)::numeric, 1.0)) AS alloc_mv
           FROM (v_portfolio_ticker_kpi k
             LEFT JOIN v_etf_holdings_norm hn ON ((hn.etf_ticker = (k.ticker)::text)))
          WHERE (k.market_value_attuale IS NOT NULL)
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT sum(base.alloc_mv) AS total_mv
           FROM base
        )
 SELECT area_geografica,
    (round(sum(alloc_mv), 2))::double precision AS market_value_attuale,
    (round(((100.0 * sum(alloc_mv)) / NULLIF(( SELECT tot.total_mv
           FROM tot), (0)::numeric)), 2))::double precision AS distribuzione_pct
   FROM base b
  GROUP BY area_geografica
  ORDER BY ((round(sum(alloc_mv), 2))::double precision) DESC;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_dist_etf AS  SELECT ticker,
    (round((market_value_attuale)::numeric, 2))::double precision AS market_value_attuale,
    (round(((100.0 * (market_value_attuale)::numeric) / NULLIF(sum((market_value_attuale)::numeric) OVER (), (0)::numeric)), 2))::double precision AS distribuzione_pct
   FROM v_portfolio_ticker_kpi k
  WHERE (market_value_attuale IS NOT NULL);;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_dist_settore AS  WITH base AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(hn.settore, 'Non mappato'::text) AS settore,
            ((k.market_value_attuale)::numeric * COALESCE((hn.peso_norm)::numeric, 1.0)) AS alloc_mv
           FROM (v_portfolio_ticker_kpi k
             LEFT JOIN v_etf_holdings_norm hn ON ((hn.etf_ticker = (k.ticker)::text)))
          WHERE (k.market_value_attuale IS NOT NULL)
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT sum(base.alloc_mv) AS total_mv
           FROM base
        )
 SELECT settore,
    (round(sum(alloc_mv), 2))::double precision AS market_value_attuale,
    (round(((100.0 * sum(alloc_mv)) / NULLIF(( SELECT tot.total_mv
           FROM tot), (0)::numeric)), 2))::double precision AS distribuzione_pct
   FROM base b
  GROUP BY settore
  ORDER BY ((round(sum(alloc_mv), 2))::double precision) DESC;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_dist_valuta_mercato AS  WITH base AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(hn.valuta_mercato, 'Non mappato'::text) AS valuta_mercato,
            ((k.market_value_attuale)::numeric * COALESCE((hn.peso_norm)::numeric, 1.0)) AS alloc_mv
           FROM (v_portfolio_ticker_kpi k
             LEFT JOIN v_etf_holdings_norm hn ON ((hn.etf_ticker = (k.ticker)::text)))
          WHERE (k.market_value_attuale IS NOT NULL)
        ), tot AS (
         SELECT sum(base.alloc_mv) AS total_mv
           FROM base
        )
 SELECT valuta_mercato,
    (round(sum(alloc_mv), 2))::double precision AS market_value_attuale,
    (round(((100.0 * sum(alloc_mv)) / NULLIF(( SELECT tot.total_mv
           FROM tot), (0)::numeric)), 2))::double precision AS distribuzione_pct
   FROM base b
  GROUP BY valuta_mercato
  ORDER BY ((round(sum(alloc_mv), 2))::double precision) DESC;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_etf_holdings_norm AS  SELECT etf_ticker,
    ticker AS holding_ticker,
    nome,
    COALESCE(settore, 'Sconosciuto'::text) AS settore,
    COALESCE(area_geografica, 'Sconosciuto'::text) AS area_geografica,
    COALESCE(valuta_mercato, 'Sconosciuto'::text) AS valuta_mercato,
    COALESCE(ponderazione, (0)::double precision) AS ponderazione_raw,
    (COALESCE(ponderazione, (0)::double precision) / NULLIF(sum(COALESCE(ponderazione, (0)::double precision)) OVER (PARTITION BY etf_ticker), (0)::double precision)) AS peso_norm
   FROM etf_holdings h;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_etf_performance AS  SELECT ticker,
    round(costo_investito_eur, 2) AS costo_investito_eur,
    (round((market_value_attuale)::numeric, 2))::double precision AS market_value_attuale,
    round(((market_value_attuale)::numeric - costo_investito_eur), 2) AS guadagno_eur,
    (round(((100.0 * ((market_value_attuale)::numeric - costo_investito_eur)) / NULLIF(abs(costo_investito_eur), (0)::numeric)), 2))::double precision AS guadagno_pct
   FROM v_portfolio_ticker_kpi k
  WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM etf_holdings h
          WHERE (h.etf_ticker = (k.ticker)::text)));;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_etf_rendimento_annuo AS  WITH first_tx AS (
         SELECT t.ticker,
            min(t.data_operazione) AS prima_operazione
           FROM transaction t
          GROUP BY t.ticker
        ), base AS (
         SELECT k.ticker,
            f.prima_operazione,
            (CURRENT_DATE - f.prima_operazione) AS giorni_investimento,
            k.costo_investito_eur,
            k.market_value_attuale
           FROM (v_portfolio_ticker_kpi k
             JOIN first_tx f ON (((f.ticker)::text = (k.ticker)::text)))
          WHERE (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                   FROM etf_holdings h
                  WHERE (h.etf_ticker = (k.ticker)::text)))
        )
 SELECT ticker,
    prima_operazione,
    giorni_investimento,
    round(costo_investito_eur, 2) AS costo_investito_eur,
    (round((market_value_attuale)::numeric, 2))::double precision AS market_value_attuale,
    (round((100.0 * (power(((market_value_attuale)::numeric / NULLIF(costo_investito_eur, (0)::numeric)), (365.0 / NULLIF((giorni_investimento)::numeric, (0)::numeric))) - (1)::numeric)), 2))::double precision AS rendimento_annuo_pct
   FROM base b
  WHERE ((costo_investito_eur IS NOT NULL) AND (market_value_attuale IS NOT NULL) AND (costo_investito_eur > (0)::numeric) AND (giorni_investimento > 0));;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_portafoglio_rendimento_annuo AS  WITH etf_universe AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT h.etf_ticker AS ticker
           FROM etf_holdings h
        ), first_tx AS (
         SELECT t.ticker,
            min(t.data_operazione) AS prima_operazione
           FROM transaction t
          GROUP BY t.ticker
        ), agg AS (
         SELECT min(f.prima_operazione) AS prima_operazione_portafoglio,
            sum(k.costo_investito_eur) AS costo_investito_tot_eur,
            (sum(k.market_value_attuale))::numeric AS market_value_tot_attuale
           FROM ((v_portfolio_ticker_kpi k
             JOIN etf_universe u ON ((u.ticker = (k.ticker)::text)))
             JOIN first_tx f ON (((f.ticker)::text = (k.ticker)::text)))
          WHERE ((k.costo_investito_eur IS NOT NULL) AND (k.market_value_attuale IS NOT NULL))
        )
 SELECT prima_operazione_portafoglio,
    (CURRENT_DATE - prima_operazione_portafoglio) AS giorni_investimento,
    round(costo_investito_tot_eur, 2) AS costo_investito_tot_eur,
    (round(market_value_tot_attuale, 2))::double precision AS market_value_tot_attuale,
    round((market_value_tot_attuale - costo_investito_tot_eur), 2) AS guadagno_tot_eur,
    (round((100.0 * (power((market_value_tot_attuale / NULLIF(costo_investito_tot_eur, (0)::numeric)), (365.0 / NULLIF(((CURRENT_DATE - prima_operazione_portafoglio))::numeric, (0)::numeric))) - (1)::numeric)), 2))::double precision AS rendimento_annuo_pct
   FROM agg a
  WHERE ((costo_investito_tot_eur > (0)::numeric) AND (prima_operazione_portafoglio IS NOT NULL));;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_portfolio_positions AS  SELECT v.ticker,
    sum(v.quantita_signed) AS quantita,
    round(sum(v.cashflow_eur_signed), 2) AS costo_investito_eur,
    max(v.data_operazione) AS ultima_operazione,
    round(avg((abs(v.importo_euro) / v.quantita)), 2) AS prezzo_medio_acquisto,
    e.price
   FROM (v_tx_normalized v
     JOIN etf_prices e ON (((v.ticker)::text = (e.ticker)::text)))
  WHERE (v.quantita <> (0)::numeric)
  GROUP BY v.ticker, e.price
 HAVING (sum(v.quantita_signed) <> (0)::numeric);;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_portfolio_ticker_kpi AS  SELECT p.ticker,
    p.quantita,
    p.costo_investito_eur,
    pr.price AS last_price,
    (round((((p.quantita)::double precision * pr.price))::numeric, 2))::double precision AS market_value_attuale
   FROM (v_portfolio_positions p
     LEFT JOIN etf_prices pr ON (((pr.ticker)::text = (p.ticker)::text)));;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_rendimento_cedole AS  SELECT sum(importo_euro) AS sum,
    descrizione
   FROM transaction
  WHERE (((ticker)::text ~~ 'M.%'::text) AND ((tipo_operazione)::text <> 'Acquisto'::text))
  GROUP BY descrizione
  ORDER BY descrizione;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_top_3_etf_guadagni AS  SELECT ticker,
    costo_investito_eur,
    market_value_attuale,
    guadagno_eur,
    guadagno_pct
   FROM v_etf_performance
  WHERE (guadagno_pct IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY guadagno_pct DESC, market_value_attuale DESC, ticker
 LIMIT 3;;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_tx_normalized AS  SELECT id,
    data_operazione,
    data_valuta,
    tipo_operazione,
    ticker,
    isin,
    protocollo,
    descrizione,
    importo_euro,
    importo_divisa,
    divisa,
    riferimento_ordine,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    quantita,
        CASE
            WHEN ((tipo_operazione)::text ~~* ANY (ARRAY['%vend%'::text, '%sell%'::text, '%rimbor%'::text, '%redem%'::text])) THEN (- COALESCE(quantita, (0)::numeric))
            ELSE COALESCE(quantita, (0)::numeric)
        END AS quantita_signed,
        CASE
            WHEN ((tipo_operazione)::text ~~* ANY (ARRAY['%vend%'::text, '%sell%'::text, '%rimbor%'::text, '%redem%'::text])) THEN (- abs(COALESCE(importo_euro, (0)::numeric)))
            ELSE abs(COALESCE(importo_euro, (0)::numeric))
        END AS cashflow_eur_signed
   FROM transaction t;;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS etf_correlations (  id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('etf_correlations_id_seq'::regclass),
  etf_symbol_1 character varying NOT NULL,
  etf_symbol_2 character varying NOT NULL,
  correlation_coefficient numeric NOT NULL,
  sample_size integer NOT NULL,
  calculation_date timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  period_start date NOT NULL,
  period_end date NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS etf_holdings (  id bigint NOT NULL,
  etf_ticker text NOT NULL,
  ticker text NOT NULL,
  nome text NOT NULL,
  settore text,
  asset_class text,
  ponderazione double precision,
  area_geografica text,
  cambio text,
  valuta_mercato text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transaction (  id bigint NOT NULL,
  data_operazione date NOT NULL,
  data_valuta date,
  tipo_operazione character varying,
  ticker character varying NOT NULL,
  isin character varying,
  protocollo numeric NOT NULL,
  descrizione character varying,
  importo_euro numeric,
  importo_divisa numeric,
  divisa character varying,
  riferimento_ordine character varying NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  quantita numeric,
  intermediario text
);
